'''TA-667''' was a [[Triumphant-class dark trooper|Triumphant-class]] [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He operated alongside [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zhanks]] sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
TA-667 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
